0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The aspiring songstress wishes to practice her singing without interruption.

25.original: Stand watch near the Clave, and defeat any threats that appear.

48.original: What have we here? An admirer, come to exult in the purity of my vocal splendor?

50.original: Grrr! You would feel <hex:021A020203>honored<hex:021A020103> to meet me if I was ever allowed to test the limits of my instrument!

51.original: One day I shall be the talk of Eulmore─nay, of all Norvrandt─but first I must secure a venue in which to practice.

52.original: If I sing at but a fraction of my full volume, the cretins around here become so unreasonably angry! Insulting, even! Thus I have taken to finding a quiet spot near the coast.

53.original: Yet even there, my scales and trills seem to drive the wildlife into a frenzy. I can scarce begin my practice before I'm forced to flee from some enraged beast!

54.original: Hmmm, you look to have seen your fair share of fighting. What say you to standing guard and allowing <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> my fair share of singing?

56.original: Ah, 'tis so invigorating to sing here─I feel as if my voice rings clear across the sea.

57.original: Now, if you would be so kind as to intercept any nuisances before they ruin my practice, I should be most appreciative!

58.original: The sound of singing is almost entirely drowned out by the waves crashing down below...

59.original: Ah, that was simply wonderful! You don't know how long it's been since I was last able to sing to my heart's content!

60.original: And it's all thanks to you!♪<hex:02100103>Let us return to town so I might show you the proper gratitude!

61.original: Thank you ever so much for your help! I almost wish I could keep you on as an assistant...

62.original: I know I seem to be struggling through a rough patch at the moment, but once I make a name for myself in Eulmore's cabaret show, the privileged will be climbing over each other to offer me patronage!

63.original: And then, when I'm wealthy and famous, you shall have the reward you deserve. For now, however, this is all I can afford... Consider it an advance payment!
